title: Walk cycle: side tracking shot (motion capture)
description: The primary motion-capture walk: a side truck at the walker's own pace, constant distance, long lens, with a grid floor so root travel can be recovered from background parallax.

body.subject: This armoured warrior, exactly as in [start_image]: {{design_lock}}.
body.action: He walks forward in a straight line at a steady natural pace of {{cadence_spm}} steps per minute, {{gait_notes}}, arms swinging opposite the legs.
body.camera: Side-on tracking shot: the camera trucks {{direction}} alongside him at exactly his walking speed, keeping him centred in profile at a constant distance, long telephoto lens, flat near-orthographic perspective, eye level at hip height.
body.style: Even flat studio light; flat light-grey studio floor marked with a regular square grid of thin dark lines; plain light-grey backdrop.
body.constraints: Full body always in frame with margin, feet visible on the floor, exactly two arms and two legs, near and far leg distinct, same armour design throughout.

design_lock.default: dark bronze plate armour, gold lion-head pauldrons, crimson cloth skirt with a gold meander hem, black undersuit
design_lock.description: what must stay unchanged: the design in words

gait_notes.default: heel strike to toe-off with the weight shifting smoothly

direction.description: the way he walks and the camera trucks

start_image.description: the full-body side view in the start pose

bytedance/seedance*.note: names references in prose; roles are start_image / end_image / video references

higgsfield/*.note: Higgsfield media roles: start_image, end_image, image_references, video_references

heygen/*.note: audio is always on and not controllable; only a first frame is taken

gates.description: anim_check: fraction of frames with the body tracked
root speed recovered from the floor grid vs stride x cadence

provenance.source: specs/prompts/PROMPT_LIBRARY.md section 3; wavespeed Seedance 2.0 template, clipdance camera guide, eachlabs Kling motion control guide
provenance.note: the grid floor: with a centred subject root travel is only recoverable from background parallax; a plain backdrop makes root speed unmeasurable
